recentItems.title: Conservatives pitch £10 billion missile defence system for UK
recentItems.description:
It’s not quite the Iron Dome originally billed, but the Conservatives promised a £10 billion air defence system to keep the UK safe under attack.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Plans for a so-called "Britannia Shield" were unveiled at the Conservative Party conference, billed as "the most significant upgrade to the country's air defences in a generation". 

Party leader Kemi Badenoch initially described it as "in essence a British Iron Dome”, implying it would deal with a similar threat of short-range rockets as that faced by the Israelis.

But questions about how it would work saw Badenoch struggle, after doubts emerged about its effectiveness in the face of the threat from Russian missile and drone attacks. 

Britannia, the Tories promised, would detect threats and stop them before they reach British soil.

recentItems.title: Officers who tasered elderly man sacked
recentItems.description:
Two police officers have been sacked for gross misconduct after an elderly amputee and care home resident Donald Burgess was pepper sprayed, tasered and hit with a baton.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Constables Stephen Smith and Rachel Comotto had been called to the care home in St Leonards-on-Sea in June 2022 after the 92-year-old dementia sufferer threatened carers with a knife.

Donald Burgess was taken to hospital where he contracted Covid and died three weeks later.

recentItems.title: Former CIA analyst: Britain may THINK TWICE before sharing secrets with Trump
recentItems.description:
Former CIA analyst turned bestselling author David McCloskey joins Anushka Asthana, where they explore the widening cracks in transatlantic intelligence sharing. Drawing on six years at Langley drafting the President’s Daily Brief across the Middle East, McCloskey’s new spy thriller, ‘London Station’, imagines the CIA and MI6 turning their covert apparatuses against one another.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Following the withdrawal of US bombers from RAF Fairford and security tensions over Iran, they discuss whether the "Special Relationship" can survive a second Trump administration. From Five Eyes burden-sharing complaints to Donald Trump’s war in Iran, can intelligence partnerships withstand growing political distrust between the UK and the US?

recentItems.title: Watch as French students clash with police in huge school protests
recentItems.description:
In France, tens of thousands were on the streets and police fired tear gas as school student protests spread across the country. Secondary schools were blockaded or closed, with teachers and parents joining the demonstrations as well.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

It escalated into clashes with riot police in several cities. The French government announced a temporary suspension of high school classes later this week in an effort to diffuse tensions.

Protesters are marching over deteriorating classroom conditions and overcrowding, demanding more investment in the system.

But with France facing a debt crisis and spiralling borrowing costs, can President Macron find a way out?
